full_details: Mistress Ansell boiled the oak-gall ink and filled the horn at twopence. You did not tell her the plot. At the Theatre you were in Love's Labour's Lost at two. The Rose bill was New World's Tragedy, and you did not cross. After the play Kemp wanted a scene instead of a fan. You wrote Peter and the musicians on a drum, with the fiddlers' names out of their catgut and no names spelled. Cowley asked if he was to be paid by the insult. His wage is ten shillings a week. Kemp took the crust.
one_sentence: You paid twopence for Monday's ink, played in the Navarre comedy, and wrote Kemp three minutes beside the bed.
title: Three minutes beside the bed, and a crust
